concepts.definition: a politically organized population occupying a defined territory under a sovereign government
the body of fundamental principles and rules by which a state is governed
the branch of government responsible primarily for making laws
the branch of government responsible for implementing laws and administering public policy
the branch of government that interprets laws and settles legal disputes
a system in which constitutional powers are divided between central and regional governments
the distribution of government powers among distinct branches to reduce concentration and abuse
the principle that public authorities and citizens are equally subject to established law
the legal right of eligible citizens to vote in public elections
an organized group seeking political power through elections in order to influence or control government policy
